steps.action: After the operator removes email from the environment, open Home and other app pages
steps.expected: The session is still signed in and every app page opens the wizard
steps.actual: / -> /welcome (Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw); /settings/users -> /welcome (Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw); /requests -> /welcome (Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw); /contracts -> /welcome (Step 1 of 8: Welcome to OpenLaw). Email source "unset".

steps.action: Work through the welcome steps step 1: on Welcome to OpenLaw select Get started
steps.expected: Your organization opens as Step 2 of 8
steps.actual: Step 2 of 8: Your organization at /welcome?step=organization. Before any organization save, Sign in showed {"start":"OpenLaw Legal Portal Sign in Email Password Sign in Help wit","logoCount":0,"logoLoaded":false}.

steps.action: Step 2: Default locale; Upload refuses a file that is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, and one over 5 MB
steps.expected: Default locale offers only English (United States); "Logo must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG image 5 MB or smaller. Pick another file."
steps.actual: Default locale offered ["English (United States)"]. A GIF and a PNG over 5 MB were refused with "Logo must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG image 5 MB or smaller. Pick another file." and no preview showed.

steps.action: Step 2: a PNG under 5 MB with more than 16 million pixels; Organization name; Continue
steps.expected: Continue shows "The logo must be a readable PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG with no more than 16 million pixels." and nothing is saved
steps.actual: A 4100 x 4000 PNG (16.4 million pixels) showed a preview. Continue showed "The logo must be a readable PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG with no more than 16 million pixels." and stayed at Step 2 of 8: Your organization; the saved organization kept no logo and the name "".

steps.action: Step 2: export the image again (a 256 x 256 PNG), choose a Default timezone, then select Set up later
steps.expected: The wizard moves to Authentication without saving the unsaved organization entries
steps.actual: Step 3 of 8: Authentication. The saved organization still had the name "", no logo and timezone UTC.

steps.action: Resume: Back keeps the unfinished entries; Continue saves Organization name, logo and Default timezone
steps.expected: After Back the name, logo and timezone drafts are still there; Continue saves them and opens Authentication
steps.actual: After Back the step still held {"name":"Harbor Legal DOC-032","logo":1,"timezone":"Europe/Lisbon"}. Continue opened Step 3 of 8: Authentication; the API read back name "Harbor Legal DOC-032", timezone Europe/Lisbon, locale en-US and a PNG logo.

steps.action: Step 2: the sign-in pages and the app header then show the saved organization name and logo
steps.expected: The staff sign-in page shows the saved name and logo
steps.actual: Before the save, Sign in showed {"start":"OpenLaw Legal Portal Sign in Email Password Sign in Help wit","logoCount":0,"logoLoaded":false}. After it, {"start":"Harbor Legal DOC-032 Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Sign in","logoCount":1,"logoLoaded":true}.

steps.action: Resume or finish later: the wizard keeps unfinished entries and the current step in this browser tab when you reload or visit Help, and returning to the wizard resumes the last step
steps.expected: An unsaved name survives reload and a Help visit; Home reopens Your organization, not Welcome
steps.actual: The unsaved name "Unsaved Name DOC-032" survived reload. Help with this page opened /documentation?topic=setup; browser Back returned to Your organization with "Unsaved Name DOC-032". Opening / went to /welcome?step=organization (Your organization) with the same unsaved name. The server still held "Harbor Legal DOC-032" (drafts do not save settings). The field was set back to the saved name.
